concepts.label: Material Discrepancy
concepts.definition: Any name change that is not defined as immaterial in 8 FAM 403.1-5.
concepts.quote: A material discrepancy is any name change that is not defined as immaterial in 8 FAM 403.1-5.

summary: A material discrepancy is defined as any name change that is not defined as immaterial in 8 FAM 403.1-5.
quote: A material discrepancy is any name change that is not defined as immaterial in 8 FAM 403.1-5.

concepts.label: Material Discrepancy Explanation
concepts.definition: The requirement for an applicant to explain material discrepancies in names across application and evidence documents.
concepts.quote: The applicant must explain any material discrepancies between the name on the application and the name recorded in the evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality and the evidence of identity (see 22 CFR 51.25).

scope_quotes: between the name on the application and the name recorded in the evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality and the evidence of identity
scope_text: Governed by cases where there are material discrepancies between the name on the application and the name recorded in the evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality and the evidence of identity.
object_quote: any material discrepancies between the name on the application and the name recorded in the evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality and the evidence of identity
object: any material discrepancies between the name on the application and the name recorded in the evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality and the evidence of identity
summary: The applicant must explain any material discrepancies between the name on the passport application and the name recorded in the evidence of U.S. citizenship or non-citizen U.S. nationality and the evidence of identity.
quote: The applicant must explain any material discrepancies between the name on the application and the name recorded in the evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality and the evidence of identity (see 22 CFR 51.25).

concepts.label: Documentation of Material Name Discrepancies
concepts.definition: Required acceptable documentation to substantiate material discrepancies between names on application, citizenship/nationality evidence, or identity evidence.
concepts.quote: Material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity must be documented by submission of one or more of the documents listed in this section (see an exception for married names in 8 FAM 403.1-4(C)).

scope_quotes: Material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity
scope_text: Governed by situations where there are material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity (with an exception for married names noted in 8 FAM 403.1-4(C)).
alternative_quotes: Documentation demonstrating change of name by operation of state law; or
choice_text: One or more of: (1) Court orders or decrees (name change orders or divorce decrees); (2) Certificates of naturalization; (3) Marriage certificates; (4) Documentation demonstrating change of name by operation of state law; or (5) Documentation of customary usage.
logic_text: submission of one or more of the documents listed in this section
object_quote: one or more of the documents listed in this section
object: one or more of the documents listed in this section: (1) Court orders or decrees: (a) Name change orders, or (b) Divorce decrees; (2) Certificates of naturalization; (3) Marriage certificates; (4) Documentation demonstrating change of name by operation of state law; or (5) Documentation of customary usage
summary: Material discrepancies between the name on the application, citizenship/nationality evidence, or identity evidence must be documented by submitting one or more of: (1) Court orders or decrees (name change orders or divorce decrees); (2) Certificates of naturalization; (3) Marriage certificates; (4) Documentation demonstrating change of name by operation of state law; or (5) Documentation of customary usage (noting an exception for married names in 8 FAM 403.1-4(C)).

concepts.label: Review for Counterfeiting or Alteration
concepts.definition: Mandatory inspection of material name change evidence for tampering or counterfeiting.
concepts.quote: Evidence of material name changes must be reviewed for evidence of counterfeiting or alteration (see 8 FAM 201.1)

scope_text: Governed by cases involving evidence of material name changes.
action: be reviewed for evidence of counterfeiting or alteration
summary: Evidence of material name changes must be reviewed for evidence of counterfeiting or alteration.
quote: Evidence of material name changes must be reviewed for evidence of counterfeiting or alteration (see 8 FAM 201.1)

concepts.label: Use of Previous Name
concepts.definition: Prohibition on continued use of a former name following a material name change unless explicitly authorized.
concepts.quote: The applicant may not continue to use a previous name after a material name change unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name

scope_text: Applies after a material name change, unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name.
summary: The applicant must not continue to use a previous name after a material name change unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name.
quote: The applicant may not continue to use a previous name after a material name change unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name (see 8 FAM 403.1-6 regarding “known as” names).

concepts.label: Evidence of Identity Requirement Possibility
concepts.definition: The possibility that evidence of identity may be required to establish the name best identifying the applicant.
concepts.quote: The applicant's name is an integral part of her/his identity. Consequently, under 22 CFR 51.23(c), evidence of identity might be required in accordance with Department guidance to establish the name that best identifies the applicant

scope_quotes: in accordance with Department guidance to establish the name that best identifies the applicant
scope_text: Governed by circumstances where Department guidance applies to establish the name that best identifies the applicant under 22 CFR 51.23(c).
context_quotes: The applicant's name is an integral part of her/his identity.
summary: Under 22 CFR 51.23(c), evidence of identity might be required in accordance with Department guidance to establish the name that best identifies the applicant.
quote: under 22 CFR 51.23(c), evidence of identity might be required in accordance with Department guidance to establish the name that best identifies the applicant

concepts.label: Suspension for Un-updated ID After Material Name Change
concepts.definition: Mandate to suspend an application when an applicant has had a material name change over a year prior to applying on Form DS-11 without updating ID.
concepts.quote: If the applicant has had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 but has not updated her/his ID to reflect the material name change, you must suspend the application to request an acceptable ID in the new name.

typed_values.name: Time elapsed since material name change
typed_values.quote: more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11

scope_quotes: If the applicant has had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 but has not updated her/his ID to reflect the material name change
scope_text: If the applicant has had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 but has not updated her/his ID to reflect the material name change.
action: suspend the application to request an acceptable ID in the new name
summary: If an applicant had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on Form DS-11 but has not updated their ID to reflect the name change, you must suspend the application to request an acceptable ID in the new name.
quote: If the applicant has had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 but has not updated her/his ID to reflect the material name change, you must suspend the application to request an acceptable ID in the new name.

concepts.label: Limited-Validity Passport Issuance for Urgent Travel
concepts.definition: Permission to issue a limited-validity passport in the requested name when travel is urgent or an emergency and time precludes requesting acceptable updated ID.
concepts.quote: If there is insufficient time to request that the applicant submit acceptable ID prior to urgent or emergency travel, a limited-validity passport may be issued in the requested name;

scope_quotes: If the applicant has had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 but has not updated her/his ID to reflect the material name change
If there is insufficient time to request that the applicant submit acceptable ID prior to urgent or emergency travel
scope_text: If the applicant has had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 but has not updated their ID, and there is insufficient time to request that the applicant submit acceptable ID prior to urgent or emergency travel.
action: be issued in the requested name
summary: If an applicant had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on Form DS-11 without updating ID, but there is insufficient time to request acceptable ID prior to urgent or emergency travel, a limited-validity passport may be issued in the requested name.
quote: If there is insufficient time to request that the applicant submit acceptable ID prior to urgent or emergency travel, a limited-validity passport may be issued in the requested name;

concepts.label: Need for Name Change Documentation
concepts.definition: The general requirement that applicants need name change documentation to update the name on their ID.
concepts.quote: The applicant generally will need the name change documentation to change the name on her/his ID.

object: the name change documentation to change the name on her/his ID
summary: The applicant generally will need the name change documentation to change the name on her/his ID.
quote: The applicant generally will need the name change documentation to change the name on her/his ID.

concepts.label: Notation of Name Change Documentation
concepts.definition: Duty to fully notate name change documentation before returning it to the applicant with an IRL.
concepts.quote: You must fully notate the name change documentation prior to returning the documentation, including that the documentation was "seen and returned," to the applicant with the information request letter (IRL);

scope_quotes: prior to returning the documentation, including that the documentation was "seen and returned," to the applicant with the information request letter (IRL)
scope_text: Governed by the process of returning name change documentation to the applicant with the information request letter (IRL).
context_quotes: The applicant generally will need the name change documentation to change the name on her/his ID.
object: the name change documentation, including that the documentation was "seen and returned,"
summary: You must fully notate the name change documentation, including that it was 'seen and returned,' prior to returning the documentation to the applicant with the information request letter (IRL).
quote: You must fully notate the name change documentation prior to returning the documentation, including that the documentation was "seen and returned," to the applicant with the information request letter (IRL);

concepts.label: Exemption from New Name ID Submission
concepts.definition: Exemption relieving applicants whose material name change was within one year of DS-11 application from submitting ID in the new name.
concepts.quote: Applicants who have had a material name change within one year of applying on a form DS-11 do not need to submit ID in the new name.

typed_values.name: Time elapsed since material name change
typed_values.quote: within one year of applying on a form DS-11

scope_quotes: Applicants who have had a material name change within one year of applying on a form DS-11
scope_text: Applies to applicants who have had a material name change within one year of applying on a form DS-11.
actor_quote: Applicants who have had a material name change within one year of applying on a form DS-11
actor: Applicants who have had a material name change within one year of applying on a form DS-11
summary: Applicants who had a material name change within one year of applying on Form DS-11 are not required to submit ID in the new name.
quote: Applicants who have had a material name change within one year of applying on a form DS-11 do not need to submit ID in the new name.

concepts.label: Requirement to Submit Name Change Documentation
concepts.definition: Requirement for applicants within one year of a material name change whose ID has not yet been changed to submit name change documentation.
concepts.quote: Applicants who have had a material name change within one year of applying on a form DS-11 do not need to submit ID in the new name. However, if the ID has not yet been changed, they must submit their name change documentation.

if the ID has not yet been changed

quote: However, if the ID has not yet been changed, they must submit their name change documentation.
